task: 109 owned persistent generator feasibility audit; design only, no repository edits, builds or tests
coordinateSystem: line numbers in the current patched classic/Stellar source caches; relevant character and Minazuki files are byte-identical between lanes
coreFinding: The Init-installed Minazuki event hook is persistent and has unknown creationActionSequence. A Q creates a distinct status object; after a later N or ticker passes the actual active-status check, SourceHostStatusOwner gives that instance to work from the trigger. The Q ownership is a separate status-instance link, never a rewrite of callback creation ancestry or trigger action.

row.siteId: explicit pinned Q AddStatus callsite string
row.invocationId: optional exact Q AbilityInvocation ID; absent if no exact action-sequence/actor match

ownedGenerators.construction: At each audited Q status AddStatus call, use one source-site helper that delegates to AddStatus once and binds the actual newly installed status owner. Xingqiu/Thoma bind synchronously inside f(param); Yelan binds inside the existing burstHitmark core task with the saved Q origin. Do not select by ability name, damage number, or last status read.

row.generatorId: exact ownedGenerators.id resolved from currently active status instance
row.origin: unchanged SourceHostOrigin including independent triggerActionSequence, callback creationActionSequence if known, parentAttackId, and statusOwner
row.queuedAttacks: array of existing AbilityQueuedAttack shape {queueId, attackId?, ability, attackTagName, frame}

ownedGeneratorTriggers.construction: In Minazuki successful triggerWithStatusOwner, capture the already resolved active StatusOwner and wrap the existing triggerFunc call with an active trigger ID. The same helper wraps Yelan skill-hit direct summonExquisiteThrow. Exact intrinsic AttackEvents are captured only at explicitly wrapped QueueAttack/QueueAttackWithSnap emission sites during that active trigger; finalize attackId without calling NextAttackID. No extra trigger on failed status/ICD/state/delay checks.

minimalAbi.sourceConfiguration: Give only Xingqiu, Yelan, and Thoma Minazuki watchers an explicit source-reviewed generator/trigger site config; other Minazuki callers remain unbound. Wrap Yelan skill hit callback at its existing successful burstKey guard.
minimalAbi.statusLifecycleReference: Join generator.statusInstanceId to existing statusInstances.instanceId; do not duplicate inferred expiry transitions. Preserve creationActionSequence Q when known and the original status lifecycle endState.

emissionSites.scope: Explicit audited queue calls, not a temporal sweep of every CaptureAttack while triggerFunc runs. Two shared core wrappers delegate QueueAttack and QueueAttackWithSnap unchanged while exposing an emitSiteId only around their native CaptureAttack.

sites.perTrigger: 0 or 1 when C>=2 and c2icd <= current frame

emissionSites.reason: Snapshot/stat/callback work inside a trigger may be synchronous. Active trigger time alone does not prove an incidental CaptureAttack belongs to the intrinsic wave.

closureRule: Require the exact Q invocation, its explicitly tagged generator activation and status instance, and all direct intrinsic Q AttackEvents from AbilityInvocation (Xingqiu 0, Yelan 1, Thoma 1). A missing activation at observation end, including Yelan before frame 76, is open.

The same status instance must have endState replaced or removed at its recorded physical end, or expired-at-end at lifecycleObservationFrame. active-at-end and unknown-at-end remain open. Equal expiry frame is still active under FindCheckExpiry; hitlag can extend Xingqiu/Thoma actual expiry.

For that generator, include every trigger row bound by exact statusInstanceId, with source-audited per-trigger AttackEvent counts. Require each queued event to have an assigned AttackID, one completed dispatch, and terminal outcome for every checked enemy. A queued/pending attack at end remains open.

A pending delayed Minazuki check or ticker task after status replacement/expiry cannot generate an attack for the old instance: on execution it checks actual status and resolves the then-current owner. It may generate for a newly cast Q and must be attributed to the new generator.

Keep callback creation ancestry (often unknown from Init), later player N/E trigger lineage, and Q status ownership separate. Do not mark a whole skill or every effect complete from these intrinsic damage opportunities.

Do not reuse the eager-root intrinsicOrigin predicate for owned trigger attacks: Minazuki hook creation is from Init and often unknown, while Yelan Skill-hit waves can have an E AttackEvent parentAttackId. The exact generatorId/status instance and active trigger ID are their ownership proof.

Require every trigger queued attack to carry one of that character’s explicit emitSite IDs and match its source-audited per-trigger count. An untagged attack within the callback interval is not silently absorbed into the Q damage contract.

activation.duration: 15*60+33, or 18*60+33 at C>=2; hitlag-aware, actual expiry may extend
activation.recast: Q AddStatus replaces exact prior instance; burstCounter/numSwords/nextRegen reset after AddStatus

attackEventsPerSuccessfulTrigger.rule: Actual c.numSwords at trigger; 2→3→2 or 2→3→5→2. Each sword is a separate QueueAttackWithSnap at burst.go:130, delay20.

additionalPaths: Q calls applyOrbital(burst.go:56); Xingqiu E also calls applyOrbital(skill.go:78), so orbitalKey/ticks cannot be asserted as uniquely Q-owned.
C2 rain sword callback schedules a resistance modifier task at burst.go:118; C6 callback grants energy. These are not additional intrinsic damage AttackEvents.

activation.timing: inside existing Q core task at burstHitmark=76, after Q f(param) returned
activation.recast: delayed Q AddStatus replaces prior instance only when the task executes; earlier triggers before replacement still belong to prior Q

attackEventsPerSuccessfulTrigger.rule: Three Exquisite Throw events at burst.go:117 plus optional C2 event at burst.go:138 when c.c2icd <= current frame. burstTravel is a mutable Q parameter and timing is observed, not fixed.

additionalPaths: Skill hit callback at internal/characters/yelan/skill.go:110-112 checks burstKey then calls summonExquisiteThrow directly, bypassing Minazuki.triggerWithStatusOwner. Each marked-target hit can invoke it; this site must be explicitly wrapped. It calls summonExquisiteThrow rather than burstWaveWrapper, so this path does not add burstICDKey; do not impose the Minazuki ICD gate on the skill-hit trigger.
Q C6 status transforms later player attacks; A4 and C4 effects are separate non-intrinsic-damage components.

activation.duration: 15*60, or 18*60 at C>=2; hitlag-aware, actual expiry may extend
activation.recast: Q AddStatus replaces exact prior instance

attackEventsPerSuccessfulTrigger.rule: One Fiery Collapse QueueAttack at burst.go:110; generated shield callback is a separate non-damage component.

additionalPaths: C4 Q energy task and C6 shield-derived attack modifier are not intrinsic Q attack events.

terminationAndRefreshEvidence.nativeReplacement: modifier.Add replaces a same-key object regardless of NativeOverwrite flag; RecordStatusAdded records prior exact owner as replaced and new instance ID
terminationAndRefreshEvidence.naturalExpiry: FindCheckExpiry is inactive only when expiry < current frame and expiry > -1. Existing end snapshot records expired-at-end only after actual retained owner is inactive; it does not invent exact expiry transition frame.
terminationAndRefreshEvidence.explicitRemoval: The three role packages contain no DeleteStatus(burstKey) or Watcher.Kill call. Generic DeleteStatus and RecordStatusRemoved exist but are not used for these burst keys in the audited source.
terminationAndRefreshEvidence.watcherHook: Installed during Init, remains registered; hook lifetime itself is not the Q generator lifetime.
terminationAndRefreshEvidence.recastTicker: Minazuki ticker checks current status and tickSrc at execution, then resolves current owner. A pending ticker from an older activation can trigger under a replacement instance; never assign by scheduling ancestry.

limitations: No generic all-effects complete flag: Xingqiu orbital can originate from E or Q; Yelan A4/C6 and Thoma shields/modifiers persist or arise outside intrinsic attack event closure.
Yelan Q status does not exist until the frame-76 task executes; before then there is no active dice generator even though the Q method returned.

If an activation, direct Yelan Skill trigger, or status terminal observation is absent/unknown, leave Q intrinsic coordination scope open rather than infer from action names, elapsed frames, or empty task queues.
Current 091 origin.statusOwner on individual attacks already gives Q ownership when Minazuki is used, but does not by itself enumerate successful trigger invocations or certify no future triggers.
